page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: 1. quia potestas illa fuit miraculosa: hæc fingitur ordinaria.
2. illa in corporaliter obsessos: hæc in peccatores.
3. illa ad tempus durans: hæc perpetua.
4. illa extra baptismum: hæc in baptismo.
Ad v. Respond. 1. Esse scandalum acceptum:
Ratio: quia abrogatio idololatriæ & superstitionum per se non lædit gloriam Dei.
Amplific. Hoc prætextu totum Pontificium regnum stabiliri posset.
2. Esse docendos infirmos de causis abrogationis ex verbo Dei.
Ad vi. Respond. 1. Institutio Christi est regula rituum Sacramentalium, non authoritas Patrum.
2. Patres antiquiores, Iustinus Martyr, Dionysius, Irenæus, &c. ignorant exorcismos ad Baptismum.
3. Patres sequentes tandem exorcizarunt ad Bapt. verè energumenos, adultos, Deo miraculis commendante Christianam fidem, contra infidelitatem gentilium.
4. De forma exorcismi infantum nihil ex patribus probari potest.
Conclusio: His consideratis & cum aliorum quoque responsis diligenter collatis, spero exorcismum neque te, neque Ecclesias illas amplius turbaturam.

page.notes: A small mark in the right margin beside the third numbered line (about "illa ad tempus durans") is probably a printer's mark or stain, not text; left out. The bottom of the page is cut by the scan edge but the catchword "Exer-" is clearly printed. The lines "Ad v." and "Ad vi" are read as italic labels within the column, not margin notes.
